model_definition.velocity: u_exit = Cv * u_ideal(p_exit)  (P8.3, unchanged; Cv multiplies velocity)
model_definition.energy: h_exit = h0 - u_exit^2/2 (kinetic-energy shortfall stays in gas enthalpy; P8.3, unchanged)

basis.Cv_central_0.985: engineering choice informed by TP-2171 corrected Cfg level and pyCycle generic Cv; NOT a measured Cv
basis.Cv_low_0.95: engineering bound: former P8.3 central (rounded TN-1757 reading); also brackets TP-2171 low-NPR Cfg 0.958 at NPR 2.5
basis.Cd_central_0.96: unchanged P8.3 engineering central (TN-1757 reading); consistent with TP-2171 measured 0.965 / 0.957 on a different nozzle
basis.ranges_are: declared engineering sensitivity envelopes, not confidence intervals, not fitted, not Trent measurements

sources.citation: Straight, D.M. and Cullom, R.R., Thrust performance of a variable-geometry, nonaxisymmetric, two-dimensional, convergent-divergent exhaust nozzle on a turbojet engine at altitude, NASA TP-2171, June 1983
sources.role: primary measurement on another machine (full-scale 2D C-D nozzle, J85-13 turbojet, altitude facility, NPR 1.6-14); central reference for Cv level and support for Cd

verified_statements.printed_p14: corrected peak gross thrust coefficient 0.985-0.990 for NPR > 4.0 (dry cruise throat, Fig. 16); 0.958 at NPR 2.5; max-afterburning setting 0.967 at NPR 2.0, 0.996 at 6.5, 0.987 at 14.0 (Fig. 17); Cd = effective/measured throat area, nearly constant above NPR 5: 0.965 dry cruise, 0.957 max-afterburning (Fig. 18)
verified_statements.printed_p15: full-scale Cd about 2 % below scale-model values; full-scale Cd decreases below NPR 5
verified_statements.printed_p30: Summary of Results items 1, 3, 5 repeat Cfg >= 0.985 above NPR 4, 0.958 at NPR 2.5 (area ratio 1.2), Cd 0.965 / 0.957 above NPR 5

definitions.Cfg: C_F = F_g / F_i, measured gross thrust over ideal 1-D isentropic gross thrust of the corrected flows (eq. 1, printed pp. 8-9); a thrust ratio
definitions.Cd: effective throat area (from corrected throat flow, mixed hot-gas temperature, measured total pressure) / measured throat area

sources.not_inferred: Cfg is not equated with Cd and no Cv is derived from Cfg: the denominator conventions differ from m_dot*u_ideal(p_exit) and Cd*A*G
